title: Learning Feedback Tombstone v1
description: Formalizes the append-only tombstone artifact written beside feedback events (I5-40). A tombstone excludes an event from every future dataset build while preserving it for audit; it never erases or rewrites the event.

eventId.description: Identity of the tombstoned feedback event.

tombstoneFingerprint.description: SHA-256 over the canonical tombstone content excluding nothing (producer-computed).
